card: SS-2026-11-W1-01 · reel_quote_broll (one generated live-action shot plus a code end card), tier O15 (10 to 20 s) · job reach · belief B1 ('your ads aren't failing, your enquiries are dying after the click'; this post is the unaware entry: a quiet phone is not a bad month but a business that waits for the next referral) · awareness unaware · cta_type send (send to a partner or friend) · hook_type contrarian · voiced narrator, AI label on.
facts:
- The owner's own words: 'telefoni nuk bie' (the phone doesn't ring).
- The owner's situation: he gets clients from referrals and Instagram, but not predictably; he wants clients every month, not by luck.
- 'The season' is the owner's assumed excuse, not a fact.
- No numbers or counts are allowed in this reel.
hook:
Visual 0-3 s: an open shop at midday in daylight, staff blurred in the back; at the owner's desk a hand lifts the phone in a deep red case and gives it one short shake, as if broken; the screen stays empty (no notifications, no numbers). Hands only.
Text hook (top third, 0-3 s): 'Telefoni s'bie? / S'është prishur. As sezoni.' [Phone not ringing? It isn't broken. Nor is the season.]
Spoken L1 (fixed): see line 1.
structure: ST6 myth vs truth, compact (one-line reframe), second-person narrator. O15 rungs: recognition (L1), the reframe/payoff (L2), CTA (L3).
actq: Would you send this reel to someone (a partner or a friend who owns a business)?
end_card: Ivory card, the spoken CTA as text: 'Dërgoja një pronari që po pret të bjerë telefoni.' plus the StraightScale wordmark. Held 16.8 to 18.0 s.

lines.sq: Telefoni nuk bie, por s'është prishur, dhe as sezoni s'e ka fajin. Po klienti yt i fundit, nga erdhi?
lines.en: The phone doesn't ring, but it isn't broken, and the season isn't to blame either. But your last client, where did they come from?
lines.super: 0-3 s text hook 'Telefoni s'bie? / S'është prishur. As sezoni.'; 3.0-8.3 s 'Klienti yt i fundit: nga erdhi?' [Your last client: where from?]
lines.visual: One continuous H3 shot (0 to 15 s), hands only. 0-1.5 s the short shake. 1.5-8.3 s the hand sets the phone face up on the desk; a thumb taps the screen awake: empty, nothing new. Behind, the shop door in soft focus, nobody coming in.

lines.sq: Nga një rekomandim? Atëherë biznesi yt pret rekomandimin e radhës.
lines.en: From a referral? Then your business is waiting for the next referral.
lines.super: 8.6-10.3 'Nga një rekomandim?' [From a referral?]; 10.3-12.5 'Biznesi pret rekomandimin e radhës' [The business waits for the next referral]
lines.visual: Same shot, slow push in to the phone on the desk; the hand rests beside it, fingers drumming once, then still: waiting. The phone stays dark.

lines.sq: Dërgoja një pronari që po pret të bjerë telefoni.
lines.en: Send it to an owner who is waiting for the phone to ring.
lines.visual: Same shot holds on the still hand by the dark phone to 15 s, then the end card (code) 15.0-18.0.

screens.visual: Daylight open shop, staff blurred behind. A hand lifts a phone in a deep red case and shakes it once, as if broken. The screen is empty.
screens.text: Telefoni s'bie? / S'është prishur. As sezoni. [Phone not ringing? It isn't broken. Nor is the season.]

screens.visual: The hand puts the phone face up on the desk; a thumb wakes the screen: empty. The shop door behind, nobody coming in.
screens.text: Klienti yt i fundit: nga erdhi? [Your last client: where did they come from?]

screens.visual: Slow push in: the hand rests beside the dark phone, drums once, then stops. Waiting.
screens.text: Nga një rekomandim? [From a referral?] then: Biznesi pret rekomandimin e radhës [The business waits for the next referral]

screens.visual: Hold on the still hand by the dark phone, then an ivory end card with the StraightScale wordmark.
screens.text: Dërgoja një pronari që po pret të bjerë telefoni. [Send it to an owner who is waiting for the phone to ring.]
